_doc: 局内肉鸽技能（abilities.json scope=shop，id 101~130）的审查结论 + 图标视觉设定。改风格不改这里；改主体/新增技能改这里。verdict 字段是**审查结论**（docs/skill-icons/README.md §3 的机器可读版），gen-prompts.mjs 会把它渲染进 skills.md。

_verdict_legend.declarative: ✔ 现有声明式词汇即可落地，零新增 TS
_verdict_legend.script: ✎ 需要一个 script_id 的 Modifier 子类（引擎已有逃逸口，4 个先例）
_verdict_legend.hook: ✎+ 需在引擎里补一处事件派发
_verdict_legend.redesign: ⟳ 原机制在本作不存在，必须换锚点（重设计）
_verdict_legend.infra: ⏸ 需召唤/经济基建，本轮只保留设计

skills.name: 分裂弹
skills.mechanism: on_attack_landed → 对同一目标追加 N 次 atk×50%/60% 的伤害（分开结算，各自走伤害管线）
skills.why: 「额外射出子弹」＝追加伤害段。伤害值要随攻击力成长（`damage.value` 是**绝对数值**、不吃攻击力），所以只能用脚本按 atk 算，声明式做不了。
skills.fix: l3「可触发暴击」→ 追加伤害带 `critMultiplier` 由脚本自行 roll，可落地。
skills.art: A single round lead ball at the centre of the frame, and from its lower left two smaller balls of the same round shape trail away in a short diagonal line, each one a clean circle with a small hole punched at its centre. Three straight grooves are cut clean through the large ball running from the upper right toward the trailing pair, splitting its face into three even wedges, and the gaps between those wedges are wide enough to read as though the ball had just come apart. A thin curved band of three short parallel slots sweeps behind the small balls to suggest speed, and a ring of small round holes is cut around the rim of every ball so each reads as cast metal rather than a flat disc. The three balls are arranged to fill the square evenly, the group spreading from the upper right corner of the mass down to the lower left, so the whole silhouette is as wide as it is tall.

skills.why: 方向要按实际站位算（声明式的 `projectile` 只能按 nearest/random 等策略选人，选不出「一条直线上更远的那些」）。
skills.art: A heavy crossbow bolt driving down the square on a steep diagonal from the upper left corner to the lower right, its four-sided iron tip pushed out past the lower right corner of three flat upright plates that stand stacked one above the other along that same diagonal. Each plate is a broad square panel with a hole punched through its centre exactly where the shaft passes, and the holes line up along one straight channel, so the three plates read as one pierced stack that reaches from the top of the frame down to the bottom. The bolt's shaft carries a short flight of four angled vanes at the upper left and a chunky squared nock behind them, all cut as solid white with slot-shaped gaps between the vanes. Two thin parallel cracks radiate out from the hole in each plate toward its corners, and a small ring of five round holes is set into every plate near its edges. The stack of plates fills the frame vertically while the bolt's head and vanes push into the two opposite corners, so the whole group is as tall as it is wide.

skills.mechanism: modify_attr [1 最大生命, +12 / +22 / +35, percent]；l3 追加 [9 生命恢复/秒, +N, add]
skills.why: 生命是普通属性，`percent` 对基础值乘算一次。生命恢复 base=0，所以 l3 那条**必须用 `add` 给固定值**（`percent` 打在 base=0 上恒为 0 —— 这门禁已被 check:affix 拦）。

skills.name: 铁壳
skills.mechanism: modify_attr [6 护甲, +2 / +4 / +7, add]（**必须 add**）；l3 追加 on_block_damage 的 10% 概率格挡 50%
skills.why: 护甲 base=0（英雄收口后不再配护甲）→ 写 `percent` 恒为 0，只能 `add` 固定值。注意护甲是**双曲减伤曲线**（`0.06a/(1+0.06|a|)`），+7 护甲 ≈ 30% 减伤，所以原稿的「+18%」不能直接当数值抄。
skills.fix: l3「受击 10% 几率格挡 50%」需要写 `event.blocked` —— 声明式动作写不了这个字段 → 要一个 on_block_damage 的脚本（与 112 圣盾共用一个小脚本）。

skills.name: 首击
skills.mechanism: on_attack_landed → 判 victim 是否满血（`hp >= getMaxHp()`），是则追加 atk×25%/45%/65%
skills.why: 「对满生命敌人」是**条件**，声明式动作只有 `chance` 没有条件 → 只能脚本。⚠ 而且**必须挂在 `on_attack_start` 上**：`on_attack_landed` 是在扣血**之后**派发的（`Entity.resolveAttackHit:395-399`），在那里读 `hp / getMaxHp()` 会**永远为假**（第一版就是这么写的）。正确分工是「`on_attack_start` 记标记、`on_attack_landed` 消费」。
skills.fix: l3「击杀后攻速 +15%（持续 2 秒）」需要 `on_kill`，而它**只发总线、不派发给 Modifier** → 脚本自己订阅 `ctx.bus` 的 `on_kill`，或砍掉这半句。
skills.art: A clenched fist driving in from the left edge of the square and landing hard on the flat face of a round target that stands to the right of it, the two meeting in the middle of the frame at the same height. The fist is one solid white mass with four knuckle holes punched across the front and three slots cut between the fingers, and a thick wrist band behind it carries a row of five round rivet holes and is cut off by the left edge of the frame. The target is a clean circle with three concentric rings cut through it as open channels, standing on a short stout base with two square feet that reach the bottom edge, and its centre is smashed inward as a jagged star-shaped hole with eight sharp points. From the point of impact a wide band of eight short straight spikes radiates outward, four reaching up toward the top edge and four reaching down toward the bottom edge, each separated from its neighbours by open space, and the whole band is taller than it is wide so it balances the reach of the fist and the target across the middle. The spikes above and below even out the width of the two masses, so the group fills the square evenly in both directions.

skills.name: 过载
skills.mechanism: 改为 modify_attr [11 伤害输出倍率, +6 / +10 / +16, percent]；l3 追加 [12 物理受伤倍率 / 13 魔法受伤倍率 减伤]
skills.why: 原稿「技能伤害 +10%、技能冷却 -12%」**两项在本作都不存在**：属性表 16 项里没有「技能伤害」也没有「冷却缩减」（`cdr` 是四个没有 AttributeType 的派生属性之一），而且**英雄永远不会施放技能**（`getCastableSkills()` 全工程无调用方，英雄技能必须是被动）→ 这条技能整条都挂在空机制上。
skills.fix: 换锚点到真实存在的乘区：伤害输出倍率（attr 11，对**所有**伤害生效，与 130 恶魔契约的「攻击力」是不同乘区，不重复）。l3 的冷却缩减砍掉，改给受伤倍率减伤，保住「越打越猛又不脆」的过载手感。

The dial face is cut away entirely as one big open circle, and inside it a bold needle stands pinned hard against the far right of its track with a wide gap left behind it on the left. Four jagged lightning bolts are cut clean through the casing and plunge inward toward the needle from the top, bottom and both sides, each bolt a wide zigzag with sharp clean corners. Behind the dial three short exhaust slots are punched out in a row, and a small round warning hole sits just above the needle's pivot. The casing spans the frame edge to edge and the four bolts push out to the corners, so the emblem squares off cleanly.

skills.name: 淘金
skills.mechanism: 脚本订阅 `ctx.bus` 的 `on_kill`（判 `killer === host`）→ `hero.gold += 1 / 2 / 3`；l2/l3 的「金币加成」改成更大的固定额
skills.why: ① 击杀奖励现在由**场景层** `Scene_Game_Stage.grantKillReward` 发（不是 Modifier 钩子），而 `on_kill` **只发总线**、不派发给 Modifier → 声明式 `events[on_kill]` 永远不触发；脚本可以自己订阅总线。② 属性表里**没有「金币获取」**（`goldGain` 是没有 AttributeType 的派生属性之一）→ 原稿的「金币加成 +8%」无处安放。
skills.fix: 脚本内 `bus.on` 必须配 `OnDestroy` 里的 `bus.off`（实体走对象池复用，不摘会重复计数）。l2/l3 的百分比加成改写成固定额（+2/+3）保住成长感。

skills.name: 圣盾
skills.mechanism: 脚本挂 `on_block_damage` 写 `event.blocked`（吸收量上限 = 最大生命 × 8%/13%/20%），自带计时器充能
skills.why: 本作的「护盾」不是实体字段，而是 `DamagePipeline` 第 3 阶段的一次拦截：事件对象带一个可变字段 `blocked`，Modifier 往里写多少就减多少伤害。声明式动作**写不了这个字段** → 必须是脚本。另外 `modifiers.cd` 这一列是**死代码**（`Modifier.Trigger()` 全工程零调用方），所以「充能冷却」要在脚本里自己计时。
skills.fix: l3「破碎时反弹 60% 伤害」用现成的 `reflect` 动作即可，可以落地。

A thick band runs around the whole rim with six round rivet holes set into it, and two chunky notches are cut out of the shield's upper corners. skills.name: 回旋镖
skills.mechanism: 改为「普攻命中后弹向次近敌人，造成 atk×60%/75%」（把原稿的「返程伤害」锚到一次弹射上）
skills.why: 原稿要的是「弹道命中后返程、返程再打一次」。本作 `Projectile` 是**纯直线、一次性**的（`tick` 到点 → `onHit` → 回收），没有返程这个概念；要真做返程得改 `Projectile` 的生命周期（引擎改动）。图标与名字保留，机制换成等价的一次弹射。
skills.fix: 与 114 追踪弹划清界限：113 = **打同一条线上的第二次**（去+回），114 = **换目标链式**。两条都走脚本。

The three standards span the full width of the frame and the poles reach top and bottom, so the emblem squares off.

skills.name: 暴击连锁
skills.mechanism: 脚本挂 `on_deal_damage`（**这个事件带 `isCrit`**）→ 判 `event.isCrit` → aoe_damage / 弹射（50%/60%/200% 三档）
skills.why: 关键口径：**`on_attack_landed` 的事件载荷里没有 `isCrit`**（`Entity.resolveAttackHit` 只发 `{attacker, target, damage, damageType}`），而 `on_deal_damage` 的载荷里有（`DamagePipeline` 的 `dmgEvent` 带 `isCrit`）→ 要「暴击时」就必须挂 `on_deal_damage`（它派发给**伤害来源**，正是英雄自己）。另外「每累计 3 次暴击」是计数器 → 也只能脚本。
skills.fix: `on_deal_damage` 会对**每一次**伤害派发（含 DoT 与追加段）→ 脚本里要防重入（本技能自己打出的 aoe 伤害会再触发一次），用 `event.ability`/递归标记过滤。
skills.art: A bold eight-pointed starburst centred in the square, drawn as one solid white star with four long points aimed up, down, left and right and four shorter points set between them, every point sharp and every gap between the points left wide open. Two heavy oval chain links are threaded through the star's horizontal points, one at each side, each link cut as a solid ring with an empty centre, and the chain continues outward as three more smaller links on the left and three on the right, all in a row. A small solid round core sits at the very centre of the star with a round hole punched through it. Four thin cracks branch off the diagonal points, and a ring of eight tiny round holes is set between the star's points. The starburst is tall and the chain runs the full width, so the silhouette comes out square.

skills.name: 闪避反击
skills.mechanism: 需在 `Entity.resolveAttackHit` 的闪避分支补一次 `DispatchEvent('on_evade')`，然后脚本挂 on_evade → 对来源 `damage` atk×150%/250%/350%
skills.why: 闪避**当前不发任何事件**：`resolveAttackHit` 里 `if (evasion > 0 && Math.random() < evasion) return 0;` 直接返回，近战连总线事件都没有；远程虽然会走 `Projectile` 的 `on_projectile_miss`，但那**只发总线**且 `reason` 只有一个 `'evaded_or_blocked'`、分不清是闪避还是格挡。所以要么补一处派发（引擎改 2 行），要么把这条技能改成挂在「受击」上。
skills.fix: 推荐补钩子（同时把「格挡」也一并区分开，108 铁壳 l3 与 112 圣盾都要用）。补钩子前这条只能降级为「受击时概率反击」。
skills.art: A broad round shield tilted steeply across the square, drawn as one solid white disc with a heavy raised boss at its centre cut as a bold dome with three round holes around it, and a thick rim band carrying eight evenly spaced round rivets. Out of the shield's face a wide curved arrow sweeps up and away to the upper right, its tail rooted at the boss and its head cut as a bold triangle, and the arrow's curve is separated from the shield by an open slot the whole way along. Below the shield a short heavy spear drives down to the lower left, its leaf-shaped head cut with a slot down the middle and two barb holes, its shaft carrying a ribbed grip of five bands. Three small sparks are punched out where the spear crosses the shield's edge. The shield is wide and the arrow and spear push into opposite corners, squaring the mass.

landed.note: **补了引擎派发**：`Entity.resolveAttackHit` 的闪避分支现在会发 `on_evade`；反击用 Modifier 7 眩晕、三阶护盾复用 45（护盾逻辑只有一份）

skills._lv1: 闪避后对伤害来源反击，造成 150% 攻击力伤害
skills._lv2: 反击伤害 250% 攻击力，并眩晕来源 0.5 秒
skills._lv3: 反击伤害 350% 攻击力，并获得最大生命 25% 的护盾（6 秒充能）

skills.name: 战旗
skills.mechanism: 改为**自身光环**：脚本 `OnTick` 每 N 秒对周围 3.5~4m 内的敌人 `apply_modifier`（破甲 attr 6 负值 / 减速 attr 5 负值），并给自己 `modify_attr [11, +15/+22/+30, percent]`
skills.why: 原稿是「周围 3.5m **友军**增伤 15%」。但本作是**单英雄塔防**：场上 team=1 只有英雄自己（没有召唤物、没有其它友军）→「给友军增伤」永远只作用于自己，等于一句废话；而「降低敌人护甲」那半句才是真正生效的部分。
skills.fix: 把「增伤」从「给友军」改成「给自己」（同一句话的玩家收益不变，但机制上能生效），把「破甲/减速」做成真光环（脚本定期扫描），名字「战旗」与图标保留 —— 旗子本来就是「我一个人插的旗」。
skills.art: A tall banner at the centre of the square, but cut short and hung wide rather than hung long: the pole is short and stout, running from the top edge of the frame to the bottom edge, and the flag that hangs from it is broad, so the cloth is clearly wider than it is tall. The pole carries a bold spearhead at its top with a slot down the blade, a squared foot at its base with a round hole, and a ribbed grip of five bands at the middle. The flag is cut into five wide vertical panels by four open slots, each panel short and broad, and its lower edge is cut into three long swallowtail points with deep gaps between them that reach out toward the bottom corners of the frame. A bold emblem of a small eight-pointed star is punched clean through the middle of the flag, and three round holes are set along the flag's leading edge. Two chunky tassels hang off the pole's head, one on each side, with slots cut between their strands, and they reach out to the left and right edges. The broad cloth and the two tassels spread to the full width of the frame, so the mass is square.

landed.note: **混装**：增伤是声明式 `modify_attr [11, percent]`（原稿「给友军」在单英雄局里等于给自己），破甲光环走脚本（Modifier 66）

skills.name: 时间回廊
skills.mechanism: 脚本挂 `on_take_damage` → 判 `host.hp <= 0` → `host.Heal(最大生命 × 30%/60%/100%)` 拦住死亡（每波 1 次）
skills.why: **能做，而且能真的拦住死亡**：`DamagePipeline` 的顺序是「先扣血（第 6 阶段）→ 派发 on_take_damage（第 7 阶段）→ 检查死亡（第 8 阶段）」，所以挂在 `on_take_damage` 上的脚本只要在事件里把血补回来，第 8 阶段的 `IsDead()` 就不成立、`Die()` 不会被调用。这是整份设计里最巧的一条。
skills.fix: 要防递归（补血本身可能触发别的伤害/治疗事件）；「每波 1 次」的计数放脚本里，`modifiers.cd` 列是死代码不可依赖。l3「重生后 3 秒无敌」用现成的 `apply_state: invulnerable` 即可。
skills.art: A tall hourglass filling the middle of the square, drawn as one solid white frame with two thick squared end-plates joined by three stout corner posts, and a bold round hole punched through each end-plate. Inside the frame two triangular bulbs of sand are cut as solid wedges, the upper one wide with a narrow throat below it and the lower one already heaped up into a flat-topped cone, and the two are separated by a small round hole at the waist. Around the hourglass a bold circular arrow sweeps clockwise as one wide curved band, its head cut as a solid triangle that points back on itself, with a long open slot separating the band from the frame all the way round. Three small round pin-holes are set into each end-plate and two thin cracks branch off the upper bulb. The hourglass is tall and the ring spreads wide, so the silhouette squares off.

landed.note: 脚本挂 `on_take_damage`：**该事件派发在死亡检查之前**，补血 + 置回 `alive` 就能真的拦住死亡；三阶无敌用 Modifier 6

skills.name: 恶魔契约
skills.mechanism: modify_attr [3 攻击力, +40 / +60 / +100, percent]；modify_attr [1 最大生命, -15 / -25 / -40, percent]
skills.why: 两个属性（3 攻击力 base=10、1 最大生命 base=100）都非零，`percent` 直接对基础值乘算，负值同样成立（`final = base × (1 + Σv/100)`）。纯声明式，零 TS。
skills.fix: l3 的「技能冷却 -25%」要砍（没有冷却缩减属性、且英雄没技能可冷却）。⚠ 减最大生命要注意 `ApplyWithMaxHpCarry` 那条口径：上限下降时当前生命要跟着钳回去，否则会出现 `hp > maxHp` 的脏数据。

The scroll's face is rolled outward at both sides into two tight spirals, each spiral cut as an open coil of three turns with wide gaps between the turns.
